inlines.v: G'ARGLE, verb transitive [Eng. to gurgle.] 1. To wash the throat and mouth with a liquid preparation, which is kept from descending into the stomach by a gentle expiration of air. 2. To warble; to play in the throat. [Unusual.] G'ARBLE, noun Any liquid preparation for washing the mouth and throat.
